trigger: User feedback requiring a ban on specified Chinese contrast-template writing in research reports.
failure_mode: Generic formulaic-contrast guidance did not name, scan, assign, or block the prohibited patterns, so the earlier R2 review did not test them. The first fixed-pattern repair also did not require disposition of every authored 不是 occurrence, and the next scope did not govern every authored 没有 occurrence or paired-negative stack.

root_cause.control_gap: No deterministic scan, prose_style_audit artifact, or R2 zero-hit gate.

prompt_changes: R2/R3/R4 publication block until zero eligible hits
Conservative authored-不是 scan with an exception disposition requirement
Conservative authored-没有 and paired-negative-stack scan with an exception disposition requirement

validation.scope_note: The report was exhaustively rewritten and re-reviewed under the authored-不是 / 没有 rule; current source/PDF scans, R2/R3/R4, and release gates are recorded for the third reissue.

historical_case_disposition.reason: The user subsequently requested a complete rewrite, then required exhaustive repairs after identifying a remaining double-denial construction and a paired-negative 没有 frame.
historical_case_disposition.reopen_requirement: Completed three times: R2, R3, R4, workspace verifier, and generic research gates were reopened for the current reissued PDF.
